what_it_is:
The SI-Bone iFuse INTRA Ti is a 3D printed minimally invasive titanium implant desined for use in the posterior percutaneous stabilization and fusion across the SI joint. If features a 3D iFuse lattice intended to improve bony adherence along with cutting blades and bone anchors to grip and compress across the SI joint. The implant featrues fenestrations to allow ingrowth of bone as well.

Features:
- 3D printed titanium with iFuse lattice structure
- Bone anchors to hold SI joint
- Cutting blades to cut across the SI cortical bone
- MIS implantation via a percutaneous posterior incision
indications: Minimally invasive intra-articular SI joint fusion.
use_notes: Intra-articular placement reduces SI joint range of motion more than ligamentous placement. Single-use instrument set (packaged sterile, no reprocessing). Simple technique designed for reproducibility.
